selection_rule.name_capability_rule: Select only target names that could reach the already frozen two-unit distinctive-token threshold: each normalized significant token of length 6-7 contributes one metadata capability unit and length >=8 contributes two. This uses no pixels or OCR outcome.
selection_rule.anchor_eligibility: Reference and query anchors must be a direct target-building pair from the frozen candidate ledger, use distinct collections, have strict explicit-zero pose projection, have no prior router target-way/item overlap, and meet the name-only capability rule.
selection_rule.ordering: For each producer stratum in fixed order, walk the frozen direct-candidate ledger and select the first metadata-capable anchor pair whose exact reciprocal reference-next and query-prev/query-next remain in the anchor collections, link reciprocally, pass strict projection, and avoid all prior items.
selection_rule.metadata_failure_policy: Record and skip an ineligible or linked-metadata-invalid candidate before selected pixels exist. Once selected, no pixel-driven substitution or resampling is allowed.
selection_rule.pixel_boundary: All ten selected anchors and neighbours are undownloaded and human/model unseen at freeze. Earlier materialized targets and items are excluded.
